_meta.maintainer: Update quarterly. Edit keywords[], conditions[], and template strings.
_meta.update_procedure: 1. Check veterans.gc.ca for policy changes. 2. Edit relevant benefit entry. 3. Bump version date. 4. Re-deploy.

benefits.name: Pain and Suffering Compensation
benefits.short: Monthly tax-free payment for service-related disability

conditions.label: Served in the CAF
Released from the CAF (honourably or with a medical release)
Injury or illness directly related to service

form_questions: What is the specific injury or diagnosis?
When did it occur or first appear?
Was it during service or training?
Do you have a medical diagnosis from a doctor?
benefits.template: The applicant is a released member of the Canadian Armed Forces who sustained [INJURY] which is attributable to service in the CAF. The condition was first identified [TIMEFRAME] and has resulted in [IMPACT]. The applicant is requesting Pain and Suffering Compensation under the Veterans Well-being Act.

benefits.name: Income Replacement Benefit
benefits.short: 90% of pre-release salary if disability prevents work

conditions.label: Served in the CAF
Released from the CAF
Disability prevents you from working at pre-release income level

form_questions: What was your rank and trade at time of release?
What was your approximate salary at release?
What disability prevents you from working?
Have you applied for Canada Pension Plan Disability?
benefits.template: The applicant, a released CAF member with the rank of [RANK], is unable to maintain gainful employment at their pre-release income level due to [DISABILITY]. The applicant seeks the Income Replacement Benefit to maintain financial stability during rehabilitation and reintegration.

benefits.name: Caregiver Recognition Benefit
benefits.short: Monthly payment to the person caring for a disabled veteran

conditions.label: The veteran has a disability benefit approved by VAC
Someone provides informal care at home

form_questions: Who is the primary caregiver (relationship to veteran)?
Does the veteran already receive a VAC disability benefit?
What daily activities does the caregiver assist with?
Is the caregiver preventing institutionalization?
benefits.template: The applicant, [CAREGIVER_NAME], provides informal care to [VETERAN_NAME], a VAC client receiving [EXISTING_BENEFIT]. The caregiver assists with [CARE_TASKS] on a daily basis, enabling the veteran to remain in the community rather than requiring institutional care.

benefits.name: Veterans Independence Program (VIP)
benefits.short: Funding for home care, housekeeping, yard maintenance

conditions.label: Served in the CAF or RCMP
Needs support to stay independent at home

form_questions: What specific home tasks are you unable to perform?
What is your current health condition limiting you?
Do you currently receive any other VAC benefits?
What is your living situation (own home, renting, with family)?
benefits.template: The applicant is a released CAF veteran whose [CONDITION] prevents them from independently managing [SPECIFIC_TASKS] in their home. VIP funding would allow the applicant to hire services for [SERVICES_NEEDED], enabling continued independence in the community.

benefits.name: Disability Benefits (Pension Act)
benefits.short: For veterans who served before April 1, 2006

conditions.label: Service occurred before April 1, 2006

form_questions: What years did you serve?
What operations or postings were you on?
What is the disability you are claiming?
Have you previously applied under the Veterans Well-being Act?
benefits.template: The applicant served in the Canadian Armed Forces during [SERVICE_PERIOD] on [OPERATIONS]. The applicant sustained [DISABILITY] attributable to that service and is applying for Disability Benefits under the Pension Act.

benefits.name: Education and Training Benefit
benefits.short: Up to $80,000 for post-secondary education or training

conditions.label: Served at least 6 years in the CAF
Released honourably from the CAF

form_questions: How many years did you serve in total?
What program or school are you planning to attend?
What career field are you retraining for?
Have you already been accepted to the program?
benefits.template: The applicant served [YEARS] years in the Canadian Armed Forces and was honourably released. The applicant seeks to attend [PROGRAM] at [INSTITUTION] to train for a career in [CAREER_FIELD], and is requesting Education and Training Benefit funding to cover tuition and related costs.

benefits.name: Rehabilitation Program
benefits.short: Free medical, psychosocial, and vocational rehab services

conditions.label: Released from the CAF
Has a physical or mental health need related to service

form_questions: What specific rehabilitation services do you need?
Is the condition related to your service?
Are you currently working? Is work affected?
Have you seen a doctor about this condition?
benefits.template: The applicant, a released CAF veteran, requires [SERVICES] related to [CONDITION] resulting from service. The rehabilitation program will assist the applicant in [GOAL], supporting successful reintegration into civilian life.

benefits.name: Case Management Services
benefits.short: Dedicated VAC case manager to coordinate your benefits

conditions.label: Released from the CAF

form_questions: What benefits are you currently receiving from VAC?
What is your primary challenge right now?
Have you previously worked with a VAC case manager?
What would you like help coordinating?
benefits.template: The applicant is a released CAF veteran with a complex needs profile that would benefit from coordinated case management. Current challenges include [CHALLENGES]. A dedicated case manager would help coordinate [SERVICES_NEEDED] and ensure the applicant accesses all entitled benefits.

benefits.name: Long Term Care Program
benefits.short: Funding for nursing home or residential care facility

conditions.label: Served in the CAF
Requires institutional-level care

form_questions: What is the veteran's current health condition?
What level of care do they currently require?
Is the veteran currently in a care facility?
What is the veteran's service history and period?
benefits.template: The applicant is a veteran of the Canadian Armed Forces whose [CONDITION] requires [LEVEL_OF_CARE] in a long-term care facility. Current care requirements include [CARE_NEEDS]. The applicant is requesting VAC funding support for placement at [FACILITY_TYPE].

benefits.name: Funeral and Burial Program
benefits.short: Covers funeral costs for eligible veterans

conditions.label: The veteran has passed away
The deceased served in the CAF or qualified service

form_questions: What was the veteran's full name and service number?
What dates did the veteran serve?
What is the approximate total cost of the funeral?
Was the veteran receiving any VAC benefits at time of death?
benefits.template: The applicant is applying on behalf of [VETERAN_NAME], a released CAF veteran who served from [SERVICE_DATES], who passed away on [DATE_OF_DEATH]. The family is requesting support through the Funeral and Burial Program to offset costs of [FUNERAL_COSTS].

clarifying_questions.served: Did you serve in the Canadian Armed Forces or RCMP?
clarifying_questions.released: Have you been released or retired from service?
clarifying_questions.injury: Did you sustain an injury or develop a health condition during your service?
clarifying_questions.cant_work: Is your condition preventing you from working or significantly affecting your income?
clarifying_questions.caregiver: Is a family member or partner providing unpaid care for you at home?
